entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I received a couple of months ago. I'd like to start a return for an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order from about 70 days ago. It looks like the item is the Pro-Line Racing Jersey. Is that correct?
That's the one. The jersey is the issue.
Understood. Just so I can process this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the material or a matter of preference with the fit?
It's just the fit. I received it as a gift and finally got a chance to try it on for a ride, but it's the wrong size. It's way too tight in the shoulders.
I see. So you're looking to exchange it or return it because the sizing wasn't right. Let me just check our return policy for that item.
Yes, I'd like to return it. An exchange might work, but I'd rather just get the refund for now.

Okay, one moment... Yes, it looks like standard items like this jersey are covered by our 90-day return policy. Since you received it 70 days ago, you are well within the window. I can go ahead and approve that return for you right now.

That's great news, thank you. I appreciate how easy that was. Now, since I'm a VIP member and I have to go through the process of packaging this up and sending it back, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my trouble? I'm already looking at a replacement.

That's a fair question. Let me check your account status... Yes, I see you're one of our top-tier customers. For the inconvenience, I can absolutely add a 15% discount voucher to your account, valid for your next purchase. Would that work for you?
Yes, that would be perfect. Thank you, David, I really appreciate you doing that.

You're very welcome. I've just processed the return authorization and applied the 15% discount to your account. You'll receive an email with the pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for being a loyal VeloFit customer. Have a great day!
